disposition_reason: Copper, chromium, cadmium, iron, lead, zinc and nickel were measured by AAS in 25 soft drink brands bought in Kazaure; Table 3 gives per-brand mean ± SD in mg/L. Pesticide results are not metal findings.

study.design: Retail survey of 25 soft drink brands for metals and pesticide residues
study.market: Kazaure Local Government Area, Jigawa State, Nigeria
study.method: 25 mL sample digested with concentrated HNO3 on hot plate, made to 50 mL; AAS with calibration plot
study.qa: Calibration standards; deionised water control; no CRM, spike recovery or blank values reported
